description:
[read-only] List the live tracks in flayr’s own sound library with title, composer, mood, uses, energy, length, a thumbnail waveform and the licence line. Library tracks are licensed for use on flayr only: no audio URL or download is offered; they are applied to a video by flayr’s render pipeline.
(Wraps GET /api/v2/music/library.)
name: music_library_list
title: List flayr library music
